name: apply_patch
description: Apply localized edits from inline text or a patch file. Supports line replacement, patch envelopes, and unified diffs.

file_path.description: Absolute target path for a single-file unified diff when its headers do not identify the file. Ignored for `*** Begin Patch` envelopes; `path` is an alias.

patch.description:
The inline edit; use exactly one format:
(A) `*** Begin Patch` with `*** Replace in line: <absolute/path>` plus `anchor:`, `old:`, `new:`.
(B) A `*** Begin Patch` envelope with `*** Update File:` / `*** Add File:` (`+`-prefixed) / `*** Delete File:` sections and `@@` hunks.
(C) A unified diff (`---`/`+++`/`diff --git` headers).

Constraints:
- No Markdown fences; no no-op edits.
- Copy source exactly (no `read_file` line prefixes); context lines must match.
- Multi-file unified diffs split automatically; unified diffs cannot delete files.
- Limit: 8000 characters (`patch_file`: 64000).

patch_file.description: Absolute path to a patch file, instead of `patch`. It must be session-temp or inside the current working directory. Mutually exclusive with `patch`; limit 64000 characters.
